name: titan_arch
notes: The Hollow Titans: three coast redwoods fused at the root and over the road into a living arch 25 m across and 36 m tall, the trunks rising as broken columns to about 35 m. The pointed opening, 6 m wide and nearly 10 m high, runs along local Z through the middle, its inner faces fire-hollowed and the north (-Z) side mossed.
